profile.headline: Staff Engineer | AI, Apple TV & Apple Vision Pro Lead at Angel
profile.summary:
Engineering leader focused on AI systems and multi-platform streaming, with deep expertise in Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro, and Smart TV platforms.

I currently split my work between two areas at Angel. As AI Lead, I design and build internal AI tools, RAG pipelines, LLM agents, and experimentation automation that accelerate product development across the company. I also build experimental AI projects, help teams integrate AI into their workflows, and mentor engineers on applied AI practices. As a platform engineer, I architect and ship high-performance streaming experiences across millions of devices.

I've led the development of cross-platform applications for Apple TV, visionOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Vizio, and Xbox, and have experience building distributed services, metadata pipelines, and playback infrastructure for large-scale streaming platforms. This includes on-site collaboration directly with senior Apple and Google executives to shape platform strategies.

While I lead teams and drive strategy, I stay deeply hands-on, contributing directly to codebases, system design, and performance optimization. I care about mentoring engineers, building strong technical culture, and shipping software that people love using.

Core Strengths:
- AI systems & applied LLMs (RAG pipelines, agents, automation frameworks)
- Multi-platform streaming & Smart TV architecture (tvOS, visionOS, Tizen, webOS, Xbox)
- Spatial computing & immersive playback experiences
- Distributed systems, microservices & metadata pipelines
- Performance engineering (HLS optimization, rendering, CPU/GPU profiling)
- Full-stack development across mobile, web, and backend
- DevOps & cloud orchestration (AWS, Azure, CI/CD, observability)
- Technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and mentorship

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer | Apple TV, Vision Pro & AI Lead
positions.description:
Staff engineer leading Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro, and next-generation Smart TV development for Angel. Drove the Apple TV app to a Top 2 ranking in the App Store, delivering significant performance gains, architectural improvements, and a premium cinematic viewing experience across millions of users.

- Represented Angel in recurring on-site meetings with senior Apple and Google executives, shaping platform strategy, resolving deep technical challenges, and building long-term, high-trust partnerships.
- Architected multi-platform streaming architecture powering Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Vizio, Xbox, and more using Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Designed and built distributed streaming systems, including microservices, metadata pipelines, and playback infrastructure optimized for performance and reliability.
- Built and launched Angel’s first visionOS application, implementing spatial UI, immersive video playback, SharePlay support, Spatial Accessory frameworks, and advanced 3D interaction patterns.
- Led mission-critical performance initiatives, improving memory usage, rendering stability, and HLS playback quality while reducing CPU/GPU load across constrained hardware.
- Provided technical leadership across teams, mentoring engineers, guiding platform direction, and aligning architecture with product and executive vision.
- Collaborated closely with backend, design, and product stakeholders to deliver high-impact platform features on accelerated timelines.
- Led AI initiatives for the company, architecting a RAG data pipeline (LLM agents, experimentation automation, intelligence tools, and data pipelines) that increased engineering velocity and improved product decision-making.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer — Smart TV Platforms
positions.description:
Owned and led the Apple TV platform end-to-end, elevating playback, UI performance, and overall viewer experience for millions of users across Angel Studios’ catalog of films and TV series.

- Drove major upgrades to Smart TV streaming experiences, delivering improvements to navigation, focus behavior, video playback reliability, and content discovery.
- Developed cross-platform Smart TV apps for Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and Xbox, leveraging Kotlin, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Swift to unify behavior and reduce platform fragmentation.
- Designed a modular, scalable UI architecture for rails-based content browsing, metadata presentation, and dynamic backgrounds/video previews.
- Implemented advanced memory-management strategies for tvOS, reducing crashes and improving smoothness during video transitions and heavy asset loading.
- Collaborated closely with backend engineers to evolve APIs, build new metadata endpoints, integrate GraphQL, and support high-performance media delivery.
- Led performance profiling efforts that meaningfully reduced CPU/GPU load across older Apple TV models and improved animation fluidity.
- Championed engineering culture by documenting platform patterns, leading technical planning, and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

Result: Transformed Angel Studios’ Smart TV experience into a premium, cinematic platform recognized by users and internal leadership for consistency, polish, and technical craftsmanship.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Provided leadership and mentorship to a team of software engineers, balancing technical management with active contributions to the engineering process. Designed, implemented, and reviewed code for key projects, ensuring high-quality deliverables. Planned and prioritized software projects while offering technical guidance and hands-on support. Recruited and onboarded top-tier talent, supervised external vendors for high-priority initiatives, and fostered cross-departmental collaboration to align development timelines with business goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Management · Engineering Management · C# · Software as a Service (SaaS)

positions.title: Senior Android Engineer
positions.description: Architected and built a high-performance Android app from scratch using MVVM and Jetpack Compose, delivering real-time sports highlights to fans. Designed a robust video streaming pipeline and led offshore teams to execute critical projects. Partnered with business stakeholders to align technical priorities with strategic goals, ensuring timely delivery of key features.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Android Development · Video · Live Video Streaming

positions.title: Lead Mobile Engineer
positions.description: Pioneered the transformation of a fitness platform to an online-first approach, integrating video streaming and playlist capabilities. Enhanced the Android codebase with Jetpack Compose, following industry best practices. Mentored team members and standardized processes through comprehensive documentation, ensuring consistent quality and collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Android Development · Live Video Streaming · Mentoring

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed native Android and iOS apps enabling vehicle interaction via Bluetooth LE. Collaborated with hardware teams to implement innovative features, architected React-based websites, and built internal libraries for enhanced productivity. Mentored team members and ensured seamless project deployments across multiple environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · iOS Development · React.js · Bluetooth Low Energy

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Delivered cutting-edge digital solutions for Fortune 500 companies like Walmart, integrating Azure cloud solutions and building scalable applications with Angular, React, and Node.js. Created hybrid mobile applications and ensured robust staging, QA, and production deployments. Proactively stayed updated on emerging technologies to drive innovation.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Angular · React.js · Node.js · Full-Stack Development
